articles.title: Company Overview
articles.markdown:
# Company

**Brightside Clinic** is a multi-location outpatient clinic network. Ops support covers appointment scheduling rules, billing codes handoff, and portal access — not clinical advice.

articles.title: Cancellation Policy
articles.markdown:
# Cancellations

Patients may cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours before the visit at no fee. Late cancels and no-shows may incur a $40 administrative fee unless waived by clinic manager for documented emergencies.

articles.title: Portal Access
articles.markdown:
# Portal

Support can resend portal invites and unlock accounts after identity check (DOB + last 4 of member ID). Support never shares clinical notes over chat.
